items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: So I told Jimmy now, I was laughing with them because he couldn't get me.

ctx.x: So I told Jimmy now, I was laughing with them because he couldn't get me. They had a big old boy up there, very big, tall boy. They used to call him Gorilla. But see, when you messed with gorilla, you had to leave because Gorilla always
could fix you up. And they said, "Oh, Gorilla," he said, "All right, Master Race."
